product_one_liner.value: ON3 Works uses proprietary AI and engineer-led vetting to find, assess and shortlist engineers, developers and IT specialists for companies hiring in the UK and Spain.
product_one_liner.notes: The official About page identifies the service as AI-led candidate search and screening plus engineer-vetted technical interviews, for employers seeking engineers, developers and IT specialists in the UK and Spain.

pricing_page.notes: The official on3works.com/pricing page is explicitly titled and headed “Pricing,” so a public pricing page exists.

named_customers.notes: The official key-facts/client section names CGI as a notable client, but the visible customer evidence provides fewer than two named customers; therefore the schema’s empty-list condition applies.

employee_band.notes: The LinkedIn company profile reports 14 employees, which falls in the 11-20 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company’s official headquarters entry gives Mallorca, Spain; Mallorca is retained as the stated headquarters location, although the company does not specify a city in that entry. | hq_country: The official company facts table states its headquarters as Mallorca, Spain.

founded_year.notes: ON3 Works’ official About page lists the founded year as 2022.

eng_blog.notes: The insights index is mainly recruiting-market research, comparisons, fee guides and salary/location content. It lists one post explaining the technical AI pipeline, not the two or more engineering/build posts required for a technical blog.

public_docs.notes: The homepage footer lists company/about, recruiting research and social links, but no product documentation or help-center link. The linked recruiting articles and FAQ are explanatory marketing/research content, not a multi-article product docs portal.

model_provider.value: Cohere for job-matching embeddings and Google Gemini and OpenAI for resume extraction; ON3 Works describes its core contextual-vetting model as a fine-tuned LLM but does not name its provider.
model_provider.notes: The Hiron privacy notice, operated by ON3 Works Ltd, names Cohere for job-matching embeddings and Gemini/OpenAI for resume extraction. The ON3 Works technical article separately calls its contextual model a fine-tuned LLM without identifying its provider, so the listed providers are role-specific disclosures and not a confirmed name for the core LLM.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The company’s Hiron privacy/legal notice explicitly names UK GDPR. It does not establish the other listed compliance labels; GDPR is included because it is named on this legal page and appears among the requested labels. | compliance_certs.0: The Hiron legal notice explicitly uses the term “UK GDPR.”

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: Tracxn classifies ON3 Works as unfunded, and BounceWatch reports zero funding rounds and no investment information; the most recent funding stage is therefore none.

raised_18mo.notes: The available funding profile says the company is unfunded and the funding-round inventory reports zero rounds, so there was no funding raised in the 18-month period.

launched_6mo.notes: The dated launch announcement found is for the separate Hostelería Mallorca division on 2026-04-13, before the six-month window beginning 2026-05-09. The later visible ON3 Works feed entries are market commentary/research, not an announced product or major feature launch.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small official team page identifies the two founders and their roles: John is CEO and Daniel co-founder; it says they started ON3 Works in 2022 and lists no C-level or VP-level joiner in the relevant year. No departure is announced on the team page.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable company facts and public site identify direct founder communication by email/video and list social links, but disclose no CRM or sales/marketing platform. No named system was found in the readable material.
